title: Bundle Ownership Rules Schema
description: Declares who owns each installed path, so install/upgrade behaviour is data the installer reads rather than branches inside it (C2). Governs the assistant-plane install process, never the product runtime.

governs.description: Which plane these rules govern. Asserted in a machine-readable field, not a comment, so policy-ci can check it.

project_owned.description: Exact paths the project owns. Never written once present, not even with -Force.

project_owned_globs.description: Glob conventions for project-owned paths, so a project can create one without coordinating with the bundle.

keyed_lists.description: Paths whose content is a keyed YAML list the project may extend. Value is "<listKey>:<itemKey>" — the list to scan and the field identifying an item.
